details: Public game/platform summaries redact session/user/private room codes; public discovery cannot opt into closed rooms. Authenticated owners can inspect their own room code; legacy clients with an unlisted session retain only the minimal room-id resume probe. Private code reverse lookup requires membership. Client headers updated, admin keys no longer depend on sessions. Initial API attempt reused only root dependencies and selected TS6 instead of nested TS5; rerun uses the complete unchanged S013 dependency layout.
benefit: Lists no longer expose closed room codes or game session identifiers; own resume and public room discovery remain available.
limits: Same original server failure set; R25 partial
